༄༅/ /bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos sde las yum ka mtsho rgyal dhā ki gtsug gi rgyan gcig ma'i phyi nang gi sgrub thabs la brten nas tshogs mchod nag 'gra

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos sde las yum ka mtsho rgyal dhā ki gtsug gi rgyan gcig ma'i phyi nang gi sgrub thabs la brten nas tshogs mchod nag 'gros su bkod pa bzhugs so//

chos sku'i zhing na rgyal yum pha rol phyin// longs sku'i zhing na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sprul sku bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i zhabs// dbyer med mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal zhabs la 'dud// gang gi phrin las rgyud lung man ngag bcud// o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas legs bkral zhing*// gu ru chos dbang zab gter las byung ba// nyams len khyer bde'i phyir du 'di na spel// de la 'dir bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos sde mtsho rgyal gyi sgrub thabs la brten nas tshogs mchod bya bar spro na/ thog mar gsang 'dus las gzhung bsrangs nas bstod bskul lhag ma'i bar dkyus ltar bya ba'am/ 'di kho na khol du bton tshe bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang: yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: oṃ pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nga ni ye nas ngang gis khro: mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang: bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshams las: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥgu ru de wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: skyabs sems rten bskyed ni/ pho brang dbus kyi rten de nyid: rang gi re ltos bla ma dang: dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha: kun gyi ngo bor gyur pa la: rnam pa bla ma mtsho rgyal lcam// rtsa gsum sprin phung 'phro bar gyur// na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas su: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca' 'o:

zhes lan gsum gyi rjes/ stong gsal 'gag pa med pa'i ngang*// rang byung sems nyid rig pa'i rtsal// ma dmar mig nang hrīḥyis mtshan: ma de'i 'od las pad 'dab bzhi: gzhal yas lhun stug nang du ni: pad steng ma bsam 'od 'phros pas: phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab steng du ni: ha ri ni sa rnam bzhi bsam: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa zhes brjod pas: ma gcig jo mo mkhar chen ma: sku mdog dkar la dmar chags pa: lha mo zhal mdzes gzi brjid can: thor cog phyed bkrol dar lngas brgyan: phyag gnyis thal sbyar snyim pa na: nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod skong: yid 'ong zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs: sku gsung thugs las 'od gsum 'phros: bdag gi gnas gsum dag tu phog: lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyangs: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob: thugs dkyil ma bsam ma nang hrī: o rgyan pad+ma bdag nyid bsam: sprul sku'i cha lugs gzi brjid can: 'od ldan byin dang ldan par bsam: ha ri ni sa yig bzhi las: na gzhon bu mo mdzes sdug bzhi: gser dngul rat+na'i phreng bas brgyan: dar gyi cod pan rnam lnga 'phur: phyag g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ru 'khrol: phyag g.yon thod pas dgos 'dod skong: gar stabs sgyur zhing dngos grub 'beb: de rnams kun las 'od zer ni: lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pa las: rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs thim// mdun du dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur// hūm̐: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs: khyed ni rnam dag dri ma med: bdag ni nyon mongs sgrib pas bsgribs: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya sarba dharma swā bhā wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ: sarba dharma sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes bshags pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya dza: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā:

zhes dang*/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang: dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams: kun bzang mchod sprin cher spel nas: bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: gsang sngags bsgrubs la rjes yi rangs: smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor skor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: snying po sems can don du bsngo: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: ces spyi ltar yan lag bdun pas tshogs gsag /gsol 'debs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: ma gcig yum chen gos dkar mo: mdangs ldan ma la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: ma gcig yum chen kun sgrol ma: 'gro kun sgrol la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: ma gcig jo mo rnal 'byor ma: bdag med ston la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: ma gcig jo mo mtsho rgyal ma: las can skyong la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: ma gcig ye shes lnga ldan ma: ye shes lnga yi dbang skur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: ma gcig gter gyi mnga' bdag mo: thugs gter gsang ba'i sgo phyes shig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: ma gcig yid bzhin nor 'chang ma: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi ma gcig 'khor: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro 'dul mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: mkha' 'gro tshad med bzhi ldan ma: ngan song skyob la gsol ba 'debs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo:

jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: ma gcig khams gsum dbang sdud ma: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a ma jo mo: jo mo la gsol ba 'debs so: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi pha la ho: zhes bsnyen pa ci rigs bzlas rjes/ bla ma mkha' 'gro'i sku yi gnas bzhi nas: 'od zer byung ba dag gi gnas bzhir thim: sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis: byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bzhi thob par gyur: ces dbang blang*/ mthar ni bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rang gi spyi gtsug spyan drangs thim// thugs yid dbyer med gcig tu 'dres// mi rtog gnyug ma'i ngang du gyur: ces brjod la mnyam par gzhag go /de ni phyi sgrub bo// las byang dngos gzhi nang sgrub la thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ swā bhā wa bi shud+dha sarba dharma swā bhā wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ: mchod rdzas thams cad stong par sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod pas rgya cher spel/ bhan+dha gzhal yas khang nang du: bcud ni rigs lnga yab yum ste: sbyor mtshams byang sems bdud rtsir zhu: 'ching grol med pa'i rang bzhin gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: zhes lan bdun dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum/ gtor ma 'dod yon phung por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum/ rak+ta byang sems dmar por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti ma hā pañtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza ho: zhes pas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ oṃ: chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sems: pad+ma rgyal po 'di skad smra:

dang po chos rnams dmigs med cing: smra brjod bral ba rdzogs pa che: blo 'das chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i: de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom: ā: blo bral de yi ngang nyid las: sems can kun la khyab pa yi: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po bsgom: hūm̐: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang nyid las: 'gro don dpag med byed pa'i slad: pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i dbus: ma bsam ma las 'od 'phros pas: ha ri ni sa dmar po bzhi: pad+ma 'dab bzhir rim par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm gu ru rkyen zlog drag mo rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza: ha ri ni sa hūm̐ sid+dhi pha la ho: bya ba'i gsang sngags de brjod pas: rang nyid jo mo rnal 'byor ma: gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas pas dbang sdud phyag rgya can: g.yon pas thod khrag rin chen bsnams: bcu drug na tshod rus rgyan can: dbu skra phyed grol sku mdog dmar: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum nyi zla brdzis: zhi ma khro tshul thugs ka na: pad+ma 'dab bzhi dmar dkyil hrī: rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: rgyan med phyag g.yas dbang sdud can: g.yon pa'i zhags pas thams cad 'gugs: dbu gtsug rta mgo rta skad 'tsher: rnam pa rta mgrin 'dra mod kyang: ngo bo o rgyan gu ru bsam: 'dab bzhir ma las yi ge bzhi: dhā ki bzhi yi ngo bor bsam: gsang sngags sgrog dang gsol gdab tshe: de rnams kun las 'od 'phros pas: pheṃ pheṃ hrīḥyi sgra dang bcas: 'od zer stong gsum gang bar bsam: snang srid dbang sdud dngos grub kyi: char 'beb 'gro drug 'dul bar bsam: gzhal yas 'dab bzhi'i yig bzhi las: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dmar mor bskyed: de yang bcu drug na tshod la: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dbang sdud: g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin: rang rang sa bon thugs kar mtshan: rang 'dra'i ḍā ki 'bum 'bum bskor: dpa' bo ging gi tshogs dang bcas: snang srid dbang sdud rang bzhin du: gar stabs shigs se sgyur bar bsgom:

bdag bskyed rkyang pa la de tsam gyis chog kyang phrin las dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ de yi phyi rol khor yug tu// bdag skyob lha dang rig 'dzin dang: rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams: dngos grub ster zhing bar chad sel: glu dang gar byed rol mo sgrog: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs stob: char sprin gtibs pa lta bur bskyed: du mar snang yang rang du gcig: thod rnga bsgrag cing gling bu 'bud: gu gul nag po'i gsur dud bdug: 'di skad byin chen dbab par bya'o: hūm̐: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig rje btsun bzhengs: dgongs shig bla ma rje btsun dgongs: rig 'dzin gnas nas sku skyod cig: rtsa ba gsum gyi dngos grub zhu: dbu la thor tshugs rgyan gyis brgyan: rin chen rgyan cha khra la la: gser gyi gdu bu si li li: rgyan cha mang po pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: rol mo mang po di ri ri: yi dam lha yi 'khor gyis bskor: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gtibs: chos skyong tshogs rnams bran du khol: dpa' bos bro rdung khrabs se khrab: dpa' mos gar byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong dang si li li: mkha' 'gro 'bum dang spungs se spung: lha srin sde brgyad sha ra ra: g.yas nas pho rgyud thibs se thib: g.yon nas mo rgyud thibs se thib: dar gyi ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: dri zhim ngad pa thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i shugs glu kyu ru ru: hūm̐ gi snang glu di ri ri: phaṭa kyi brda skad sangs se sang: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs: sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs: dbang bzhi rdzogs par bdag la skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bzhengs shig yi dam lha tshogs bzhengs: dgongs shig rgyal ba rigs lnga dgongs:

rkyen zlog rdo rje drag mo rtsal: mkha' 'gro gtsug gi rgyan gcig ma: chos kyi dbyings nas sku skyod 'tshal: dbu la thor tshugs sogs man chad 'gre'o: hūm̐: bzhengs shig ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhengs: dgongs shig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: ye shes mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs: dur khrod gnas nas sku skyod 'tshal: dbu la thor tshugs sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrīḥm pheṃ pheṃ kā wā tsi sid+dhi hūm̐ ā: bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: rin chen pho brang nyams re dga': dur khrod gzhal yas byin re che: pad+ma 'dab bzhi mdangs re gsal: rtog med ro ldan bag re dro: nyi zla brtsegs pa 'od re gsal: bzhugs pa'i gnas su dwangs re spro: gu ru yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgyes shing byin gyis rlob phyir bzhugs: mos pa'i bu la zhal bstan 'tshal: gsung gi gdams pa'i gnad bsgrag 'tshal: thugs kyi dgongs pa'i sgo dbye 'tshal: 'gro ba'i don du sku bzhugs 'tshal: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni/ e ma ho: skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol: yid bzhin dngos grub char 'beb pa'i: thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: spros bral kun bzang bde chen mo: rdo rje sman gcig mtsho rgyal yum: bde stong gnyis med thabs shes sbyor: yab yum gnyis med phyag 'tshal lo: bya byed yid chos rnam par dag: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams 'dul: dbang chen rta mchog yab yum la: gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: mkha' 'gro ging la phyag 'tshal lo: thams cad chos kyi dbyings su rol: chos srung tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: phyi mchod ni/ hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan yid 'ong rnams: spyan shangs thugs ka sku lus dang: zhal dang snyan du mchod par 'bul:

gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da pū dza ho: nang mchod ni/ hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: rang byung nang mchod 'bul ba ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog mchod: gsur chen bdug spos dri yis mchod: zhun chen snang gsal mar mes mchod: rdo rje dri chu'i byug pas mchod: bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas mchod: rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras mchod: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod: gnyis su med par thim gyur cig: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: gsang mchod ni/ hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: gnyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang las: byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i mchog: bde ba'i ro snyoms mchod par 'bul: sku lus rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza ho: sman mchod ni/ oṃ: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: dug lnga sel phyir ye shes lnga rdzogs rdzas: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi:

rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ ā: 'dod chags rnam dag pad+ma rak+ta 'di: rgyud drug kun sgrol khams gsum dbang du sdud: bde mchog bde spyod rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā rak+ta khā hi: gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs shing: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: ba liṃ rgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul: sman raka bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: ting 'dzin rtse gcig mchod pa 'bul: bla ma rig 'dzin mchod pa bzhes: yi dam lha tshogs mchod pa bzhes: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: ging gi tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dwangs re spro: dur khrod gnas mchog nyams re dga': zhing chen bla re rgyan dang ldan: sha sna snying sna bsam mi khyab: spro dga'i gnas kyi mchod pa bzhes: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hrī: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: dpal dang ldan pa'i yum gcig mtsho rgyal lcam// snang srid dbang sdud rkyen zlog drag mo rtsal// ye shes mkha' 'gro yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur// gtso 'khor sprul par bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// snang ba ma 'gags thugs rje chen po'i sku: rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i klong: rdo rje phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i mkha' dbyings las: thugs rje mi 'gag cir yang ston cing sgyur: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:

dam can srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsol 'debs dngos grub bskul ba ni/ oṃ: sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: sku mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub stsol: ā: gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol: ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: gsung snying po lung gi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol: sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: skye med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: hrī: sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs: ye shes lnga yi dbang skur cig: gsol 'debs brgyud 'dzin byin gyis rlobs: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par skur: ba zlas pa ni/ snang srid gzhal yas bla ma lha: thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che: dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: snang la rang bzhin med par sgoms: zhes dgongs pa'i srog tu bzung la/ bzlas pas thugs dam bskul ba las// lha tshogs rnams las 'od 'phros pas: phaiṃ phaiṃ hrīḥyi sgra dang bcas: 'od zer stong gsum gang bar 'phros: snang srid dbang bsdus dngos grub kyi: char phab 'gro drug thams cad btul: snod bcud gzugs sgra dran rtog kun// lha sngags chos sku'i ngo bor gyur// ces gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa hūm̐ sid+dhi pha la ho: zhes bzla/ (gter gzhung rtsa bar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm gu ru rkyen zlog drag mo rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza: ha ri ni sa hūm̐ sid+dhi pha la ho: zhes dang ha ri ni sa'i yig bzhi dkrugs te bzla bar yang gsungs/mchan/) thun mthar stong tshigs 'bul/ de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bshams par bdud rtsi bran la/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas bsang la/ hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge spro: raṃ: raṃ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs: yaṃ: yaṃ las rlung byung bag chags gtor:

khaṃ: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: byin gyis rlob pa'i yi ge spros: hūm̐: hūm̐ gis rnam par rtog pa sbyangs: ā: āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: oṃ: oṃ gyis 'dod yon snang srid gang: hrī: hrīḥyis mthong snang lha tshogs dgyes: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: zhes byin gyis brlab bo// de nas las rdor gyis tshogs rdzas rnams slob dpon la phyogs pas bzung ste/ ho: gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: 'di la the tshom bya mi rung: bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: zhes brjod slob dpon gyis pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ rin thang med las legs 'ongs chos: 'dod chags dri ma rnam par dag: gzung dang 'dzin pa kun spangs pa'i: de bzhin nyid ni bdag kyang 'tshal: zhes brjod cing blang ngo*// de nas tshogs phud cha gsum du bcad pa'i dang pos mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bar pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig bdag lus ngag sems kyis: rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams pa: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya ā: tha ma bsgral bstab bya ba ni/ hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: phyag g.yas dbang sdud phyag rgya can: g.yon pa phur bus dgra snying gzir: gnod byed pho mo rdul du rlog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm gu ru rkyen zlog drag mo rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza: nṛ tri shā trūn dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa a yaṃ rbad: ces tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa dang ldan pas bsgral la/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ khā hi: bhin+dha ya bhin+dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa:

ces sha khrag bdud rtsir sbar la bstab bo// rjes 'brel skong bshags kyi rim pa'ang spro na 'dir bya'o// tshogs rdzas rnams/ ho: tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: a la la ho: zhes pas drangs shing nang gi sbyin sreg gis rol lo// de nas lhag ma bsdus pa dam tshig gi kha phru btab pas byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mi mchod du: pad+ma he ru ka phud kyi bdag: bar du lhag mas mi mchod du: ma dang mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes: tha ma gcig tu mi bsre ru: gnyis med chos sku gcig las byung: hūm̐: bcom ldan pad+ma he ru ka: yum chen rdo rje phag mo la: bka' yi lhag sdud tshogs kyis bskor: lhag ma'i tshogs la rol pa rnams: 'dir byon bka' yi lhag gtor bzhes: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro// bshal chus brtan ma skyong ba ni/ 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir spar la/ hūm̐: brtan ma skyong mdzad ma dang sring: dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma: me tog zla 'od byang rgyal ma: gser thang kun bzang shān+tiṃ dpal: klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i: brtan ma bcu gnyis gtor ma longs: mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zlog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛta khā hi ma ma khā hi khā hi: zhes bshal chus mchod/ rjes rim thog mar mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: ma gcig jo mo 'khor dang bcas: phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs la rol: thugs dam gnyan skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm puṣ+pe dhū pe sogs nas/ shab+da pū dza ho: badz+ra ni ra ti hūm̐: gu ru rkyen zlog drag mo rtsal: badz+ra ma ma yaṃ dzaḥha ri ni sa hūm̐: ma hā ba liṃ ta a mṛta ma hā rak+ta bo dhi tsit+ta i daṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: snang stong dbyer med chos rnams kun gyi gzhi:

mi skye mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid: gang la cis 'dul de la der ston pa'i: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod cing*/ 1$0000270mkha' 'gro'i dbang gi dngos grub rang nyid zhu ba'i 'dun pas bla ma yi dam spyan drangs 1$0000300 nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la: sngon tshe ji ltar dbang bskur pas: bdag kyang lha mor dbang bskur zhing: dngos grub mchog kyang bstsal du gsol: de ltar gsol ba gdab par bya: lan du bla ma nyid kyis kyang: dbyer med chen por dbang bskur bas: gsang gsum gnas nas byung ba yi: rtsa ba gsum gyi dam bsrung na: sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang sbyin bya: gnang ba thob nas 'di ltar ro: bla ma thugs ka'i rta mgrin las: rigs lnga yab yum bum pa thogs: bdag gi spyi bor bdud rtsi'i dbang: blugs pas tshangs bug nang du babs: lus kyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam: chu rngub mtha' ma spyi gtsug 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā lnga las: ye shes lnga yis dbur brgyan bsam: des ni bum pa'i dbang thob cing: sku yi dngos grub thob pa yin: bla ma yi dam skur bsgom ste: sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar 'dres: bdag gi lce thog babs par bsam: rang lus bde bas rgyas par bsgom: ngag gi sgrib dag gsung dbang thob: gsung gi dngos grub thob par bsam: de nas bla ma'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas: bdag gi snying gar phog cing thim: gsal la 'dzin med bde nyams skyes: yid kyi sgrib pa dag par bsam: shes rab ye shes dbang thob cing: thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa yin: de nas bla ma rang la tshur: thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi: sgrib pa ma rig dri ma dag: dran rtog dbyings su thim par bsam: rig pa khong glod rang sems nyid: ma bcos spros bral ngang la bzhag: rig pa ye shes dbang thob cing: mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin: dbang rdzogs bla mar dbang yon gyis:

mnyes par bya ba shin tu gces: bla ma'i dam tshig ci gsung bsgrub: yi dam dam tshig sgrub la brtson: ḍā ki'i dam tshig gsang thub pa: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam par sbyor: de nas tshogs gtor dngos grub blang: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi ma hā pha la a la la ho: ( ma hā sid+dha ā yur sid+dhi dz+nyā na sid+dhi sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ ā: gter gzhung mchod pa'i rjes 'di 'dra yod/ mchan/) zhes pas dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams myang ngo*// oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya ma nu pā lā ya/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī twe no pa sogs nas/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī mā me muñtsa badz+ra ḍā ki nī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ lan gsum dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ gshegs bsdu ni/ tshogs mgron sogs rten la brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol skabs dang sbyar/ bdag bskyed la dmigs te/ hūm̐ hūm̐: snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha: mkha' la sprin ltar dbyings su thim: gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang: don gyi mkha' 'gro'i rang zhal blta: a a a: oṃ āḥhūm̐: slar yang gzugs sgra dran rtog kun: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs: ye shes sgyu mar mnyam sbyar bas: mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don la 'jug: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bsngo smon ni/ e ma ho: bdag gis 'gro ba kun don du: bskal pa dpag med tshun chad nas: tha ma da lta thug gi bar: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis: bla ma skyes mchog yi dam lha: sangs rgyas byang sems ḍā ki'i tshogs: sgom sgrub mchod cing bstod pa dang: bris bklags bcangs shing kun chub bgyis: lta dgongs la sogs dge spyad pa'i: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin gyur nas: kun mkhyen ye shes mchog thob shog: gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi: bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs shing: dus gsum pha mas sna drangs pa'i: 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa:

bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: shis pa brjod pa ni/ shes bya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa'i don 'grub pa'i: don grub mchog gi bkra shis shog: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga nas: phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod pas dge legs su bya'o/ ༈ /'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub byed na thog mar phyi sgrub la maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog tshom bu bkod pa'i mthar nyer spyod kyis bskor/ mtshams bcad la thun bzhir dril te nyams su blang*/ skyabs sems gsag sbyang 'bum phrag sogs 'gro ba dang*/ khyad par gsol 'debs bsnyen sngags byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma ma byung bar 'bad do// tha na'ang bsnyen pa bye ba 'grub nges bya'o// de nas sgrub pa la dkyil 'khor pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i steng mañdzi la sgrub gtor pad+ma brtsegs pa dang*/ nang sgrub ltar gyi sku tsaka sin+dhu ra yis bris pa bkod/ rgyab ngos sman raka gtor gsum dang nyer spyod mchod tshogs kyis bskor/ rnga dang dril bu ḍā ru rkang: gsur dud mar me rus rgyan bsham: gsungs pa ltar bya/ mtshams dam par gcad/ gzhi bgegs la gtor ma bsngo/ rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis: bka' bsgo gsang sngags 'di skad brjod: oṃ pad+ma kro dhi shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de nas skyabs sems nas gzung phyi sgrub khyug tsam tshul bzhin gtang*/ nang sgrub mchod pa byin rlabs nas dmigs gnad things bar sgom bzlas la 'jug /sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po byung ba'am/ sgrub sngags 'bum phrag bzhi'am bdun grub pa dang mnyam du dbang dang dngos grub blang*/ 'di'i skabs thams cad du mchod tshogs gtor 'bul rgyas par bya/ kha skong zhi sbyin ci nus blugs la mtha' rgyas su+u bya'o// gsang sgrub ni phyi sgrub tsam gnad du things pa na bla ma'i zhal shes ltar dus dang rgyun du nyams su blang ba dang mi 'bral bar rgyun bskyangs pas rang rig ye shes mkha' 'gror tshe 'dir grol ba gdon mi za bas mos ldan rnams kyis rtse gcig tu nyams su blang bar byos shig
